# Brimholt repository instructions

- Brimholt is an original working name, not verified trademark/name clearance. Do not reuse proprietary Tibia artwork, maps, names, or code.
- Use Godot 4.5+, typed GDScript, and native ENet/MultiplayerAPI. No Node server, third-party APIs, or paid services. Downloaded assets must be CC0, kept in `assets/third_party/` with their license file and a row in `assets/third_party/CREDITS.md`.
- Open Tibia engines are high-level references, not dependencies: do not copy/translate GPL code without a licensing decision; MIT reuse needs file/dependency checks and applicable notices. Neither source license licenses proprietary Tibia assets. See README.md.
- The world is `game/maps/overworld.tscn`, painted in Godot's TileMap editor (terrain custom data, plus Spawns/Ferrymen/Items markers). Treat that scene as the source of truth; do not regenerate it with `tools/generators/make_map.gd --force` without the user's approval.
- The game is a small LAN prototype for up to twelve players (Knight, Paladin, Sorcerer, Druid vocations): original 32-pixel tile map, cardinal grid movement, collision, smooth presentation, host/join, visibly equipped items, a flat backpack with ground items and drag-and-drop, nine equipment slots, ten gear tiers (every five levels, accessories from 20, vocation weapons) and glowing level-50 relics from final-boss quests, a 768×768 world (generated by `tools/generators/make_map.gd`) with a top-to-bottom coastal ferry, safe towns (zones flagged `town`) ringing a central lake whose island (Blackreed Isle) is a level 40-50 PvP hunting zone, coaches between towns for fast travel, the Hollow Reach endgame zone in the south-east (high-risk level 45-50 PvP where dying drops all gear but bound relics, obsidian Sanctum with the ultimate boss; painted by `tools/generators/endgame_zone.gd`), and level 1-50 balance curves anchored on a 350,000-health final boss that needs a ten-player, all-vocation raid (`game/data/balance.gd`, `docs/balance.md`).
- Derive new mob, item, and progression numbers from `game/data/balance.gd` rather than inventing standalone values; regenerate `docs/balance.md` with `tools/generators/balance_table.gd` when constants change.
- Combat is Tibia-style and server-authoritative in `game/core/combat.gd` (target lock, 2 s auto-attacks, spells with own and group cooldowns, monster aggro/leash/respawn, experience shared by damage or pooled in a party (`Combat.party_action`, shared-experience rules), per-monster loot tables in `Monsters.LOOT`, 10% death penalty with classic item loss, white/red skulls, PvP only in PvP zones). Derive monster and spell numbers from `game/data/balance.gd`; never trust clients with damage, health, or experience.
- Run `python3 tools/testing/playtest.py --godot godot` after gameplay changes that affect the main loop; read its findings, not just pass/fail.
- Keep nested containers, player-to-player trading, blessings, procedural caves, floor systems, world persistence (ground items, monsters), accounts beyond the identity token, and AI or dialogue-driven NPCs out unless the user selects them as a milestone. Characters persist only on the host (`game/persistence/`): never accept save data, positions, or stats from clients, keep saves signed and sanitized on load, and keep tests off the player's real saves (`--no-save`, `--fresh-identity`, `--save-dir`). Ferrymen, vendors, bankers, and quest givers are static, menu-driven NPCs; vendor stock, prices, the bank, and the depot are server-validated (`game/core/economy.gd`, `World.move_item`).
- NPC interaction is a right-click context menu of services (Travel, Trade, Bank, Quests), never Tibia-style typed keywords. Add new services to that menu.
- Player input goes through `game/input/keybinds.gd`: never hard-code gameplay keys. New actions need a default binding there; the action bar has nine rebindable slots (default 1-9) that hold spells only (`"spell:<id>"` or empty); other actions get their own bindings in `Keybinds.DEFAULTS`.
- Peer 1 owns all gameplay state. Keep input ownership separate from node multiplayer authority. Validate RPC senders; clients request actions, never positions or authoritative appearance.
- Enforce movement timing, walkability, occupancy, item moves (reach, slot type, capacity, cooldown), and player limits on the server. Synchronize spawn, late-join, equipment, ground-item, and disconnect state reliably; send backpack contents only to their owner.
- Preserve host/client behavior parity. Art is original sprite sheets in `assets/sprites` (see `docs/art.md`): one layered sheet per worn item, never a sprite per combination, and never ripped, proprietary, or Tibia-derived assets (CC0 effect textures live in `assets/third_party/`).
- Inspect actual files and reuse existing helpers before editing. Make surgical changes, keep types explicit, and surface errors.
- Consult the relevant repository skill before gameplay, networking, equipment, or validation work.
- Check tooling before claiming results. Use bounded checks, report what actually ran, and never bypass denied permissions.
- Keep registered checkout paths stable. Do not publish a repository, add a remote, or install system-wide tools without authorization.
- Layout and conventions are in `docs/architecture.md`: simulation in `game/core/`, catalogs in `game/data/`, drawing in `game/render/`, tests by kind under `tests/unit|integration|visual/`, generators and test runners under `tools/`. Use `make` targets (`make help`) for import, tests, and generators; update the relevant `docs/*.md` with each feature.
- Items live in `game/data/items.json` (shared with the sprite generator); stats derive from `game/data/items.gd`. Never hand-tune per-item stats unless the row sets `stats`. Relics are bound quest rewards (`Combat.claim_relic`), never loot.
- Rendering layers: the world draws in its own SubViewport with `lighting.gd` (day/night, zone ambient, point lights), `glow_layer.gd`, and `fx.gd`; anything that must stay readable (names, bars, numbers) goes in `world_overlay.gd`. Bosses use raid mechanics in `Combat._boss_tick` (enrage, pulses, wounds; Knights swap with Challenge).
